notes.title: Huge update
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I hope the update works and there are no problems with errors or similar. If you find errors, please report them to me. Most of the updates are in the background for better performance and cleaner gameplay. You can also see your personal best lap at the end of the target screen. I also changed the lobby settings menu for a better, cleaner look. I hope you like the update and if you have some ideas for features, tell me these.

with friendly greet rydeom
